entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. This expensive VeloBand you sold me is a complete piece of junk. It's broken and I want my money back immediately.
I'm very sorry to hear you're experiencing an issue. I can certainly look into that. Could I please get your order number to pull up your details?

It's VF-2025-99812. And don't waste my time. This thing is defective. The pulse tracking is not working, it's totally inaccurate, and now the whole band won't sync with my phone. I want a refund, not a runaround.
I understand your frustration. Just so I'm clear on the best way to help, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?

Are you serious? I just told you it's broken! It's defective! It's not working! I am not interested in your troubleshooting games. I want to return this garbage. If you don't process my refund right now, I swear I will write a review on every single website about this. Get me your manager.
That won't be necessary, sir, I assure you I can resolve this for you. Let me just pull up your order... Okay, I see here the delivery was made 41 days ago. Let me just check the policy.
Alright, I've just consulted our knowledge base. It looks like you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. I can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you.
Oh. Ninety days? Okay, well that's something. So you're taking it back then?

Yes, of course. I have already authorized the return in our system. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Please pack the defective band back in its box, apply the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location.
Okay, fine. That's all I wanted in the first place. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be credited back to your original payment method within 5 to 7 business days. Is there anything else I can help with?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
